# Siderise

> Siderise is a global leader in passive fire protection, acoustic insulation, and thermal solutions for building envelopes and curtain walling systems.

Siderise specializes in fire safety, acoustic control, and thermal insulation technologies with operations across North America, Europe, UK, Middle East, Asia Pacific, and India. The company operates a Global Innovation Centre for advanced fire safety testing and product development.

## Key Topics

- Fire safety
- Passive fire protection
- Acoustic insulation
- Building envelope
- Curtain walling
- Lamella stone wool technology
- Noise control
- Thermal insulation
- BIM services
- Technical support
- Global operations
- Innovation and R&D
- ISO certifications
- Sustainability
- Building regulations compliance

## Core Solutions

- [Fire Safety](https://www.siderise.com/fire-safety): Passive fire protection solutions for building envelopes and curtain walling
- [Acoustics](https://www.siderise.com/acoustics): Acoustic solutions for noise control and building acoustics
- [Lamella](https://www.siderise.com/lamella): Lamella stone wool insulation technology for passive fire protection
- [The Siderise Difference](https://www.siderise.com/the-siderise-difference): Competitive advantages, technical expertise and quality assurance
